evals.prompt: I want to get started with Versal AI Engine. I have about 2 hours today. Can you help me figure out what to study?
evals.expected_output: Should recommend the Versal AI Engine Quick Start or Architecture course with level, duration, board requirement, spec sheet link, and portal link.

assertions.text: names-correct-course: Response includes 'Versal AI Engine' course name (Quick Start or Architecture)
includes-level: Response states course level (Level 1 or similar)
includes-duration: Response mentions course duration (e.g., 8h, 16 hours)
includes-spec-link: Response includes a docs.amd.com link
includes-portal-link: Response includes a learningcatalog-amd.netexam.com link
includes-board-info: Response mentions board requirement (Not Applicable for AIE courses)
no-fabricated-links: All links match real known patterns from the course catalog

evals.prompt: I only have 20 minutes. I want to learn something about PetaLinux.
evals.expected_output: Should look up the PetaLinux PPT and recommend 1-2 specific modules covereable in under 20-30 minutes. Should name actual modules from the PPT.

assertions.text: names-specific-module: Response names a specific module from the PetaLinux PPT, not just the course title
time-appropriate: Recommended content is described as covereable in 20-30 minutes
no-fabricated-content: Content references something that appears to come from the actual PPT, not generic AI knowledge
correct-time-bucket: Skill correctly identifies this as a less-than-30-minute scenario

evals.prompt: I'm an embedded software engineer new to AMD. I have a full day free and want a custom training plan on Zynq UltraScale+ MPSoC embedded software development. I have a ZCU104 board available.
evals.expected_output: Should build an 8-hour custom agenda with 10-20 topics and labs, timed slots, morning/afternoon structure, board info, and offer to modify.

assertions.text: has-timed-agenda: Response includes specific time slots (e.g., 09:00-09:30 format)
has-morning-afternoon: Response has both Morning and Afternoon session sections
10-to-20-topics: Between 10 and 20 distinct topics or modules are listed
includes-lab: At least one hands-on lab is included in the agenda
mentions-board: ZCU104 or board requirement is explicitly mentioned
offers-modification: Response ends with offer to adjust or modify the plan
real-module-names: Module names are specific and appear sourced from actual course PPTs, not generic descriptions
